scope: Complete raw atmosphere regeneration provenance and obtain independent raw-model validation nodes; do not implement or re-audit Citlali.
custody_constraints: Supply files locally with SHA-256 provenance; Codex must not access Unity.
Do not substitute a contemporary am release, current LMT site defaults, synthetic profiles, or guessed bandpass weights for the historical inputs.
Do not fetch the recorded TolTECA HTTP endpoint as part of this package; an owner or data custodian must stage the intended bytes.

required_items.request: Stage the original am_q95 raw NPZ bytes registered by TolTECA as datafile ID 461, expected MD5 0ca7b331823237767d26016d19bffb3d, and report filename, byte count, SHA-256, and custody source.
acceptance: MD5 exactly equals 0ca7b331823237767d26016d19bffb3d.
NPZ members and shapes are inventoried without rewriting the file.
The 225-GHz/80-degree transmission is compared with the repair-base q95 literal 0.7337698; any mismatch is reported rather than normalized.

required_items.request: Supply the exact Scott Paine am source/release or executable used for these grids, including every local patch, build option, dependency lock, and SHA-256 identity.
acceptance: A clean environment can identify the same executable/source payload by SHA-256.
The supplied version is tied to the historical production rather than inferred solely from the July 2022 DOI citation.

required_items.request: Supply the exact raw-grid generation command as an argv array plus all am configuration/control files, environment variables that affect numerical output, output parser/packer, and the original Mapping-Speed-Calculator source snapshot at gitlink commit 843cb1f44ef5f9ebaa842b296a7328f9bf64b908 or its verified successor containing that generator.
acceptance: No shell-history-only or prose-only command; every referenced input is staged and SHA-256 identified.
The command declares frequency output, elevation/slant paths, units, precision, and NPZ packing order.

required_items.request: Supply the complete q25/q50/q75/q95 atmosphere profile/config files used by am, byte-for-byte with SHA-256 provenance.
acceptance: Every profile layer, constituent, temperature/pressure/humidity quantity, boundary condition, and unit is explicit.
Profile-to-q-model identity is one-to-one and recorded in the manifest.

required_items.request: Supply the MERRA product/version, time range, spatial sampling, variables, vertical-coordinate conversion, quality filtering, and percentile-construction statistic that produced the four profiles.
acceptance: The derivation can be rerun from immutable or digest-identified inputs.
The meaning of q25/q50/q75/q95 is stated explicitly; it is not inferred from selector tau225 values.

required_items.request: Supply the exact LMT latitude, longitude convention, altitude/reference datum, ground or ambient boundary inputs, Earth/atmosphere geometry, refraction/curvature settings, and elevation-to-slant-path directives used by am.
acceptance: Values come from the historical run configuration or an owner-approved replacement explicitly labeled as a new convention.
The raw-generator slant geometry is kept distinct from Citlali's downstream modified-secant sample-airmass formula.

required_items.request: Confirm the generator directives that produced the recovered 0--500 GHz, 0.01-GHz, 50,001-point grid and the 20--80 degree, 2-degree, 31-point grid, including endpoint inclusion, numeric precision, atmTtx direction/reference plane, and atmTRJ definition.
acceptance: A rerun reproduces array names, shapes, coordinate ordering, and units without post hoc resampling.
The recorded dissertation text discrepancy (10--80 degrees in 10-degree steps versus recovered arrays at 20--80 degrees in 2-degree steps) is resolved by provenance, not silently edited.

required_items.request: Provide independent atmosphere-model calculations at preregistered intermediate zenith tau225 nodes 6.94133915289252557e-02, 1.23326285582665493e-01, and 2.31590792882712782e-01, or approve a different blinded holdout design before generation. Supply the physical profile-construction rule for each node rather than scaling a fitted transmission surface.
acceptance: Runs cover the full proposed operational elevation and spectral grid.
Candidate fitting does not consume the held-out outputs before the operator definitions and error metric are frozen.
At least one independent run lies in each q25--q50, q50--q75, and q75--q95 interval.

required_items.request: Choose whether the successor preserves the recovered legacy monochromatic convention (recommended for faithful lineage closure) or intentionally changes to a band-integrated operator. Record the choice as a versioned scientific convention.
acceptance: A monochromatic choice fixes 272.73, 214.29, and 150.00 GHz with 225.00 GHz as the reference.
A band-integrated choice is labeled a new model version and triggers BAND-001-CONDITIONAL.

required_items.request: If SPEC-001 selects band integration, identify exact passband arrays and SHA-256 values, array/detector aggregation, normalization, source spectral weighting convention and reference spectrum, interpolation/quadrature rule, out-of-band handling, and the definition of the band/reference transmission ratio.
acceptance: All three bandpasses and their generator/release are immutable and versioned.
Integration reproduces a frozen reference table in an independent rerun.

required_items.request: Approve the operational zenith-tau225 and aligned-elevation domain. The present 30--80 degree analysis is diagnostic only; the recovered raw grid supports 20--80 degrees, and no extrapolation is authorized.
acceptance: Minimum and maximum values, endpoint inclusivity, out-of-domain fail-closed behavior, and any data-quality eligibility rules are explicit.
The domain is contained in the supplied raw and held-out model support.

facts_already_recovered_do_not_request_a: Complete q25/q50/q75 NPZ grids and their SHA-256/registry MD5 identities.
Raw grid coordinates: 0--500 GHz at 0.01 GHz and 20--80 degrees at 2 degrees.
Legacy nominal samples: 272.73, 214.29, 150.00, and reference 225.00 GHz.
Legacy fit: numpy.polyfit degree six in elevation radians over 31 nodes, coefficient rounding to eight decimals, and no passband integration.
Selector zenith-tau225 anchors derived as -log(T225 at 80 degrees)/X(80 degrees); q25/q50/q75 are verified against raw bytes.

delivery_layout.digest_file: SHA256SUMS with paths relative to the delivery root
delivery_layout.immutability: Preserve original bytes; generated normalized tables are separate derived artifacts.
